source: Source observations private/predict-source-2; Safari successfully activated official draw. Current protocol preserves existing drafts by requiring an empty prestate.

cases.source: Actual UI-copied original prediction report; private/result-source-safari-1/copied-report-address.ax.txt. Both endpoints must have no selected PI winners or locked result.

Already locked test prediction from the observed anonymous autofill/lock UI. Random brackets stay distinct; this case compares champion, choice counts, copy feedback and retention of each endpoint actual timestamp and choices.

tournament.scope: Complete anonymous local prediction traversal, per-round gating, locking and persistence. Random brackets remain actual data; no seed injection or copying of browser storage.
tournament.preparation: Same owned ordinary desktop Safari private window and full share query. Require actual empty draft; preserve any existing draft. Default displayed strength reference 隐藏分.
tournament.choice_policy: Within each unselected match, choose the higher displayed win probability; lexical label tie-break for displayed ties. Record actual before/after AX and chosen labels.
steps: Capture empty draft; reveal official PI draw; fill its six matches individually.
For Swiss rounds 1 through 5, start the observed draw, capture unselected pairs, fill 8/8/8/6/3 matches and observe future-round gating.
Observe knockout draw, choose four quarterfinal, two semifinal and one final winners individually.
Paste poster nickname; lock; reload through actual home entry; review retained choices in all seven rounds.
Change final winner; observe unlocked draft with saved record retained; attempt reset; copy actual current report.
Restore original final winner; observe automatic return of original lock timestamp; copy preferred report; edit again and reload.
Import the actual source-copied preferred report on both origins; compare its visible teams and each own compatibility score; collapse and reload.
tournament.limits: No claim of exact random bracket or lock timestamp equality across independent origins. Shared report content and each origin own persistence must be compared separately.
observed_findings: Lock stores a prediction record separately from the editable draft. Changing the final winner unlocks the draft; restoring the original winner restores the saved lock timestamp automatically.
Original and candidate reset attempts are no-ops under the observed iframe sandbox. Existing storage is never cleared by the driver.
Reloading the full original share entry returns to home; reopen My Prediction through its primary link. Choices and saved record persist; nickname resets to B站召唤师.
Actual clipboard report is plain text plus URL. Safari omnibar inspection requires Escape twice to restore its actual address before guarded captures.
Published report points to the same origin at /index.html; both / and /index.html were verified HTTP 200. Imported friend code comes from the source report, independently from each origin own report.
Anonymous saved predictions do not join public user rankings, as stated by original Who Is Most Accurate view. Follow-gated poster and topic posting remain unexercised.
